steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I have to admit, I wasn't expecting that.

options: Up until I saw Saria do it...

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Rest assured. I have no intention of going back to prison either.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Then that makes cleaning up the scene of the crime here a lot easier.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: After all, I'm a mechanist. Won't take much time to pull a machine apart.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But I'm wondering... How did you know it was empty inside?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I've sparred with this power suit a few times before.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You've been hunted by them too?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: In a sense.

options: Could be the other way around, honestly...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: If they're showing up here, that goes to show someone really doesn't want us tracking Muelsyse's whereabouts.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Who's that someone going to be?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: There are many possibilities.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I don't contact Muelsyse much. I only know she was participating in some Rhine Lab-headed secret experiment before she disappeared.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Considering I left Rhine long ago, her divulging as much to me already violated her NDA.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Does Rhine Defense dispatch cutting-edge weapons to eliminate info-leaking employees?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Got it. That's non-disclosure too.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Rhodes Island sure is a friendly enterprise, isn't it, Dr. {@nickname}?

options: Rhodes Island isn't just an enterprise.
How else did we get either of you?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Muelsyse isn't an ordinary Rhine Lab employee.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: If they can drive her to the edge, their professionalism has to be on par with mine.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: This model of power armor made a showing in certain mercenary groups about half a year ago.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Neither its defensive material nor its equipped weaponry are outstanding. All in all, it's comparable to military-manufactured power armor from five years ago.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Save for one very notable point—it doesn't demand anything from its user.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Anything... how low do the requirements go?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Any being whose physiological parameters can maintain a standard exercise state satisfies the requirements.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I can, you can, and the Doctor can.

options: I'm kind of dying to try.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: You won't like the feeling of it, Doctor, I can guarantee you.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Only crack troops used to be able to wear power armor.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Picture controlling that giant contraption for extended periods of fighting, and not drowning in your own vomit in the process—it genuinely wasn't something anyone could do without training.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Ask Dur-nar, she'll tell you. She says she wore it one time ever, and it made her want to quit the military right then and there.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: I imagine these intervening years have been enough for them to iterate the technology a couple dozen times over, and there's no shortage of vets among the mercenaries...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: But for anyone to wear it?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: That's an invention that might change how whole wars are fought.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Similar power armors are only out there in extremely low numbers, which makes it obvious this tech is only in its prototype phase.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm on the trail of its source right now. Getting leads isn't a cakewalk, as with so many other experimental weapons.

options: This power armor's extremely advanced tech, right?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The mercs may not be clients.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: In the eyes of the people who order this stuff, mercenaries and these latest power suits are interchangeable—

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: —It's only experimental.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The edge projected from nomadic cities is often the boundary where the rules of civilization no longer apply.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The mercenaries active in the barrens, same as the Pioneers, are the most convenient test subjects.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Even if an experiment fails, and they're disposed of, hardly anyone is going to pursue their whereabouts.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: And soon enough, the next batch of test subjects gets funneled in.

options: Don't any of them fight it?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: No point in fighting it.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The mercenaries are fully aware the new weapons in their hands could explode, but they could also be stronger than whatever their opponents are wielding.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Legally, these mutually consenting deals are on the verge of compliance.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Mr. Mechanist, have you discovered anything new?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Something feels off...

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Something's felt off from the very beginning.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Nobody in the power armor—how did I not tell that at a glance?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: The mercs could be remote-controlling it from a distance, or maybe they set it up with automated programming—but no matter what, there'd be distinct patterns in its behavior.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Obviously, they're not that flexible.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: Even the highest grade of automation out of the newest crop of Rhodes Island's R&D weaponry wouldn't escape my eyes—you want me to believe that bunch of dumb army-funded mechanists could pull it off?

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Severing the power armor's 'central nerves.'

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: There's something dripping out of these tubes... a silver liquid.

steps.name: Mechanist
steps.text: What is this substance?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Maybe it's the answer to your question.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Did we... get away?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: *pant*... I... I haven't run this fast in a long time...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What exactly was...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It followed us?!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This isn't the same one as before...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: There're at least ten—even more, actually. They've surrounded the living quarters.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: They're... multiplying.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Multiplying? Have you seen those things before? Explain!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Dr. Urbica, shouldn't you be the one explaining?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What the ever-loving hell do you mean...?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Move—!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: —This thing's too fast!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't want to imagine what happens if it touches you—do you think we should head back inside?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Better we don't.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's... the building we were in...
Under an invisible, massively powerful attack, the Pioneers' hut violently sways, the flimsy windows and doors shattering in quick succession.
At practically the same time, the peculiar objects that were hanging in the air before fly straight at the room.
Silver liquid oozes through the cracks in every frame at lightning speed, just as a minute creature would smell blood and dig fearlessly into its prey's wounds.
But in the next instant, something that defies all comprehension, including the scientists', decides to take place.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did that building just... disappear?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No. It didn't disappear—it was disintegrated.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Do you see those... things floating in the air?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You're trying to tell me that—used to be part of the building?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I fear that may be the entire building.
Just as her voice falls silent, the fragments frozen in midair come falling down one after another.
Cacophony, dust, detritus everywhere, like the restarting of a clock stopped by force—and everything that existed by all rights returns.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did... Did I get hit by some kind of mind-control Arts?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I mean, if not, then everything I just saw... somehow violated every law of physics I know.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's the work of those silver liquids.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: They... dispersed into innumerable minute individuals, dismantled and lifted away what was a section of that room...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: And then reassembled it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Like there were dozens of invisible... hands?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sounds like you ladies are talking about ghosts.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Wait, Ptilopsis—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Shit, Joyce was just in that room!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Don't tell me she got...

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: *cough*... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Myers! You made it out too?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: S—Sir... I got... Doc Moore... outta there...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Joyce!

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Th—Thank God... she's okay...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: His wounds aren't severe, but his endurance has been overtaxed. He urgently needs rest.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We can't hang around this place. None of the Pioneer quarters are safe anymore.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Did you see that?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: I don't know what you're referring to.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Knock it off, I know you're not that dumb. Did you not feel that tremor just now?

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Were those floaty things some new model of drone or something? You Rhiners developed those yourself? Dammit!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: I can only tell you that we did not take any action against the site, on your orders.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Who was your boss, again? Ferdinand?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Mr. Ferdinand Clooney is the Director of Rhine Lab's Energy Section.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: I don't care how your company's structured.

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Give me your comm. I want to talk to him.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Clooney is extremely busy...

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Then I'm gonna need you to pass along a message—

steps.name: Mary
steps.text: Ask if he knows what a bastard he is!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Director, you have a message, sent from observation at the site.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Well, well...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Also, your son appears to need you for something. Should I put him through?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Same play. Tell him I'm busy.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Right, send the contents of Elena's most recent report to my terminal.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: On it, Director.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: How many times have I told you? Don't call me Director.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Tech
steps.text: Ah! Sorry, Mr. Clooney.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Speaking of Elena...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I gather you get along well with her.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Brainstorm for me. What kind of present would she like?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Olivia.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm sorry, treating the wounded Pioneers has me occupied...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm... fine.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't have field experience like you do, but I can take care of myself, at least.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Even then... shouldn't we be evacuating ASAP?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The whole site's in chaos... The Pioneers are busy with themselves. We've got a good opportunity to escape.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm positive the director got my message. He'll send people to fetch us.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Once we meet back up with our colleagues at Defense, we'll be in a perfect position to wipe out the threat to the site, and save Dorothy.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Maybe you're right.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Maybe?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I can't do it. It's not in my power to leave these people for dead.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Just now, they couldn't do it... leave Joyce for dead. You saw.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Silence, we still got a few casualties here!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Drone—!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We're not gonna last much longer if they keep this up.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I've tried every way to attack it, no dice. Those freaks don't hurt, and they're impossible to break.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We don't even... got nowhere to hide.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Sir, why are you telling them all this?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: They could be getting off on it!

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: These things above our heads are all mystery weapons sent out by the fuzz and the megacorps! They want us trapped in this test site forever—

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam, lay off that for now.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Everyone, I... I've got an idea...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Greyy... do you have some kind of proposal?

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Take your time. You were running too fast. Be careful not to bruise yourself.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I've noticed—those objects seem to chase after light, and human voices.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Watch...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: They're following your Arts' light ball, away into the air.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: *pant*... It's only temporary.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: My Arts aren't able to trick them for long.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You've done all you can. And very well, at that.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Phototaxis... You've brought up an interesting line of thought.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Greyy, can you assist in evacuating the nearby Pioneers? They trust you.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Move them somewhere dark, and tell them they need to keep quiet.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Sure, I know what to do.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I've done work like this plenty of times with the senior operators...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Dr. Silence, you and Miss Elena take care too.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What about us, then?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Make some signs of movement. The larger, the better. It has to cover the sounds of the others' footsteps at minimum.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sam, call five or six guys over if you can, take whatever gear makes the most noise.

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Are you seriously going along with them?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: You got a better idea?

steps.name: Frontier Team Member
steps.text: Whatever you say, boss.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Draw every silver body to our location.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: So we act as bait—and then what?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: For now, stall as long as we can.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: And then come to the laboratories.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: That voice...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dorothy?!

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Yes, it's me. Dorothy.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: I did a quick rig on the laboratory PAs—I hope I didn't scare you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: I'm completely safe. You don't need to worry about me.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: The laboratory buildings are sturdier, and they will help you resist the threat.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Everyone—be you Pioneer Team friends, or Rhine coworkers, the laboratories' doors are open to you.
